title: 第1630章 交换生雅雅第1629章 剑士交谈
content_zh:
那并非依靠秘术遮蔽气息的伪装，而是将自身一切波动归于虚无。
没有奔涌的气血，没有起伏的心绪，更无半分外泄的剑意，近乎脱离了常人能感知到的范畴。
倘若这人拔剑突袭，在生出杀意之前，自己根本无从预警。
想到此处，波丽儿指尖不断收紧，指节泛白，目光牢牢锁在黑发少女脸上。
灰水心也察觉到气氛突变，原本蓄势待发的视线从波丽儿身上移开，打量这名始终沉默的黑发少女。
果然。
波丽儿也注意到了。
黑发少女察觉到两道视线落在自己身上，缓缓抬眼。
她没有展露锋芒，唇角平淡无波，不见争强好胜的锐气，只是平静回望波丽儿紧绷的模样。
“不必戒备。”少女声音清淡，音量适中，刚好让两人听清，“我无意与任何人争先。”
“无意争先？”波丽儿眉头紧锁，心底不肯相信。
能把气息收敛到这种境界的剑修，不可能甘于平庸，或者说，所谓无欲无求根本就是笑话。
你都无欲无求了，你还修炼个什么？
想修炼，习惯修炼，那就是有欲望，有所求。
“能做到气息归零，你的剑术造诣，远超同龄常人。既修剑道，何来不争一说。”
灰水心适时开口：“剑道道路万千，有人以胜负证道，有人以静心证道，未必所有人都执着于切磋输赢。”
“不过能修炼出这般藏锋本事，足以证明你的根基有多恐怖。不知师从何处？”
黑发少女轻轻摇头：“无固定师门，四处游历，随缘观摩各路剑招。”
这是谎言。
她的身份敏感，不适合随便暴露，更不能大摇大摆的在公众面前出手。

就连这次出来，都是她求了好久的。
可对于一心剑道的另外两名少女来说，这却是完全不一样了。
她们，是真的信了。
毕竟，如此厉害的剑道，如果有师傅肯定会想着帮对方发扬光大，又或者，以引为傲的自报家门。
切磋就是如此。
技法万千，总要有个代称，才能有所分别，才能较个高下。反而是刻意隐瞒，或者居功自傲者，为人不齿，甚至难以谈得上剑术。
毕竟，一个连自己“父母”都不敢说出来的家伙，一个连自己“父母”都要强占的家伙，不配谈剑术，也就不可能被邀请来到这里。
因此，她们在正经切磋，正经场合下，基本都会光明正大自报家门。
这是潜规则，也是明面上的规则。
在这样的背景下，黑发少女此言一出，波丽儿心头震动无比。
孤山流、秋水流皆是传承有序的剑道流派，她们自幼年便得到顶尖强者手把手传授心法招式，日复一日规范化打磨剑术。
眼前少女独自摸索修行，就能抵达这种层次，天赋之恐怖，难以估量。
content_en:
That is not a disguise that relies on secret techniques to cover the breath, but to return all fluctuations in oneself to nothingness.
There is no surging energy and blood, no ups and downs of emotions, and no leakage of sword intent. It is almost beyond the scope of what ordinary people can perceive.
If this man drew his sword and made a surprise attack, he would have no way of warning him before he had the intention to kill.
Thinking of this, Paulier's fingertips continued to tighten, her knuckles turned white, and her eyes were firmly locked on the black-haired girl's face.
Hui Shuixin also noticed the sudden change in the atmosphere. He moved his gaze away from Paulier, who was preparing to attack, and looked at the dark-haired girl who had always been silent.
really.
Pauline noticed it too.
The black-haired girl noticed two eyes falling on her and slowly raised her eyes.
She didn't show any sharpness, her lips were flat, and there was no competitive edge. She just calmly looked back at Paulier's tense expression.
"There is no need to be alert." The girl's voice was light and the volume was moderate, just enough for the two of them to hear clearly, "I have no intention of competing with anyone."
"Have no intention of competing first?" Paulier frowned, refusing to believe it in her heart.
A swordsman who can control his aura to such a state cannot be content with mediocrity. In other words, the so-called "no desires and no pursuits" is simply a joke.
If you no longer have any desires or desires, why are you still cultivating?
If you want to practice and are used to practicing, you have desires and demands.
"Being able to return your aura to zero means your swordsmanship is far beyond that of ordinary people of your age. Since you are a master of swordsmanship, how can you not argue about it?"
Hui Shuixin spoke at the right time: "There are many ways to the sword. Some people prove it through victory and defeat, and some people use meditation to prove it. Not everyone may be obsessed with winning or losing."
"But being able to cultivate such a hidden edge ability is enough to prove how terrifying your foundation is. I wonder where you learned from it?"
The black-haired girl shook her head slightly: "I don't have a fixed master. I travel around and observe various sword moves as I see fit."
This is a lie.
Her identity is sensitive and is not suitable for being exposed casually, let alone being arrogant in public.
Even coming out this time was something she had been begging for for a long time.
But for the other two girls in Isshin Kendo, this was completely different.
They really believed it.
After all, if there is such a powerful swordsman, if there is a master, he will definitely want to help the other person carry it forward, or he will be proud of his own family.
That's what sparring is like.
There are thousands of techniques, and they all need to have a name so that they can be distinguished and compared with each other. On the contrary, those who deliberately conceal it or take credit for themselves are despised and cannot even speak of swordsmanship.
After all, a guy who doesn't even dare to tell his "parents", a guy who wants to take over his "parents" by force, is not worthy of talking about swordsmanship, so it is impossible to be invited here.
Therefore, when they compete in serious situations, they will basically declare their family status openly and honestly.
This is a hidden rule as well as an explicit rule.
In this context, when the black-haired girl said this, Polly's heart was extremely shocked.
Both Gushan Ryu and Qiu Shuiliu are kendo schools that have been inherited in an orderly manner. They have been taught step by step by top experts in their mental techniques since they were young, and they have standardized and polished their sword skills day after day.
The girl in front of her can reach this level by practicing alone. Her talent is terrifying and difficult to estimate.
